response.description:
Azure Elastic SAN now supports single volume snapshots,
enabling incremental, point‑in‑time backups of individual SAN volumes.
Snapshots capture only changes since the previous snapshot and reside within
the SAN, allowing customers to quickly deploy new volumes from a restore point
or export data to managed disk snapshots for long‑term retention. Snapshots are
capacity efficient, consume SAN storage instead of incurring separate billing,
and inherit the redundancy configuration of the parent SAN.
Snapshots consume provisioned SAN capacity rather than incurring separate
billing and can be exported to managed disk snapshots for longer‑term retention
beyond the lifecycle of the source volume. Snapshot redundancy is automatically
aligned with the redundancy configuration of the parent Elastic SAN. Learn more.
response.title: Generally Available: Single Volume Snapshots on Azure Elastic SAN
